title: SRI pay stub to Puharich's Lab Nine

tellings.quote: disappeared. Not true. There's a a pay stub in Puharich's archives that is a is from SRI to lab nine Puharich's lab from 73.

plain: A researcher named Greg says there is a pay stub in the archives of Andrija Puharich, a researcher of psychic phenomena, showing a 1973 payment from SRI, the Stanford Research Institute, a California research organisation, to Puharich's own lab, called Lab Nine, in Ossining, New York. Greg brings it up to push back on the idea that Puharich had simply disappeared from that world, since it would mean SRI was still paying him.
